thread.title: Indexes Rise Early; Is This Warren Buffett's Favorite Stock?

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Indexes Rise Early; Is This Warren Buffett's Favorite Stock?
text:
The stock market opened higher Monday, with Dow Jones industrial average leading the way, up 0.7%. The Nasdaq composite picked up 0.7% and S&P 500 added 0.6%.
X Early movers in the Dow included Walt Disney ( DIS ) and Intel ( INTC ), with gains of 0.8% and 1.8%, respectively. Disney's film, "Black Panther," surpassed $100 million in its second weekend in U.S. theaters, the second best second-week performance of all time, according to published reports.
Meanwhile, shares of Apple ( AAPL ) were up 1.2% after Warren Buffet in an interview on CNBC said that he bought more Apple than anything else in the past year. Apple is now Berkshire Hathaway 's ( BRKA ) second-largest holding, according to Buffett's annual letter released Saturday.
Steel stocks rallied again after Bloomberg reported that President Trump is considering a 24% tariff on steel imports and 10% on aluminum imports. Steel Dynamics ( STLD ), Nucor ( NUE ), U.S. Steel ( X ) and AK Steel ( AKS ) were all higher in the early going.
Of the four, Nucor has the healthiest chart. It just completed a six-week, cup-shaped base with a conventional entry at 70.58.
Aluminum producer Alcoa ( AA ) added 0.5% just after the open, but it's still entrenched below the 50-day moving average. Shares could hit potential resistance around 50.50.
Amazon.com ( AMZN ) gained 1.1%.
Inside the IBD 50 , China-based Skechers ( WB ) was higher by 1% as it gets support at the 10-week moving average .

The U.S. Dollar index was lower ahead of congressional testimony from new Fed chief Jerome Powell on Tuesday and Wednesday. The 10-year Treasury yield was down 3 basis points to 2.84% as the market debates how many interest rate hikes are in store for 2018. The 10-year yield was firmly lower Friday after the Fed, in a report to Congress, stuck to its stance that it does not plan to hike rates aggressively this year.
After the close, watch for earnings from Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ). Shares eased 0.2% to 165.13 ahead of the results. Headed into Monday, the security software name was slightly extended from a 156.95 buy point.
Results from Square ( SQ ) and JD.com ( JD ) are also due this week. Both were featured as potential call option trades in the latest Earnings Preview column.
